newsitem.title: UK: ICI hits peak after Merrill comment.
newsitem.headline: ICI hits peak after Merrill comment.

text.p: Shares in Imperial Chemical Industries Plc hit a record high on Wednesday as Merrill Lynch repeated an "accumulate" rating on the stock, arguing that its restructuring was ocurring faster than expected, dealers said.
ICI shares were up 20p at 975-1/2 by 1315 GMT -- after earlier hitting a peak of 977p -- in volume of 3.8 million shares.
Dealers said the stock was also lifted by a strong performance in its ADRs in New York, up $1/2 on Tuesday at $63-1/2.
ICI on July 14 announced the sale of half its bulk chemical operations to DuPont Co, its second major restructuring deal following the purchase of Unilever Plc's speciality chemicals business.
Analysts at Merrill were not immediately available for comment.
